section.title: TplAppMysql Class Reference
Detailed Description
section.para: This class provides methods to generate and manage menu items, actions, and sections related to MySQL within the Bearsampp application. It includes functionalities for enabling/disabling MySQL, switching versions, changing ports, managing services, and debugging.
